title: UAPI: require_fips flag absent from GET_STATE output
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info (returned by CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_GET_STATE) does not include the require_fips flag. The per-fd require_fips field is set by CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS and changes subsequent INIT behavior (non-FIPS providers are rejected). A caller who wants to audit or reconstruct the full state of an fd cannot determine whether REQUIRE_FIPS was set. The state struct is documented as supporting 'both OPERATION and KEY fds' and is the sole introspection surface. Adding require_fips now costs a reserved __u32 slot; deferring makes it an ABI-bump addition later. Suggested fix: add '__u32 require_fips;' to the struct and populate it in ioctl_get_state, consuming one of the implicit future reserved bytes.
